name: com.githubcard/mcp
title: GitHubCard
description: Create GitHub profile and repository cards for READMEs, link previews and social posts.

tools.name: create_card
tools.description: Create (or reuse) a published card image for a GitHub profile or repository. Returns svg/png URLs and markdown/html embed snippets. Idempotent; counts once against the daily quota.

subject.description: GitHub username (e.g. octocat) or owner/repo (e.g. octocat/hello-world)

template.description: template id from list_templates; omit for the subject's default layout

palette.description: background palette id from list_palettes; omit for the template's own background. For any other colour use design

format.description: which link to return as url: "svg" (default; best for README embeds) or "png". Both are always in urls

watermark.description: false removes the watermark (Pro only; ignored on Free)

design.description: a design document from get_template_design or get_card_design, possibly edited; replaces template and palette

tools.name: preview_card
tools.description: Render a PNG for visual review before publishing. Uses one daily card unit on success. Creates no card or public link.

subject.description: GitHub username (e.g. octocat) or owner/repo (e.g. octocat/hello-world)

template.description: template id from list_templates; omit for the subject's default layout

palette.description: background palette id from list_palettes; omit for the template's own background. For any other colour use design

design.description: a design document from get_template_design or get_card_design, possibly edited; replaces template and palette

watermark.description: false removes the watermark (Pro only; ignored on Free)

tools.name: validate_card
tools.description: Dry run of create_card with the same inputs: checks template/palette ids, Pro features and the design document, without creating anything or using quota. warnings lists layers that reach outside the artboard (they would be clipped); fix those before create_card.

subject.description: GitHub username (e.g. octocat) or owner/repo (e.g. octocat/hello-world)

template.description: template id from list_templates; omit for the subject's default layout

palette.description: background palette id from list_palettes; omit for the template's own background. For any other colour use design

format.description: which link to return as url: "svg" (default; best for README embeds) or "png". Both are always in urls

watermark.description: false removes the watermark (Pro only; ignored on Free)

design.description: a design document from get_template_design or get_card_design, possibly edited; replaces template and palette

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List card layouts with their ids, scope (profile/repo/all), size, widget types, and whether they need Pro.

scope.description: profile or repo; omit for all. Results include scope=all templates, which fit both

freeOnly.description: only templates available on the Free plan

widgets.description: only templates containing all of these widget types (from list_components)

tools.name: list_palettes
tools.description: List background palette ids accepted by create_card.

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List the widget (layer) types a design can contain: the scope (profile/repo) each fits, the layer settings each reads ("options", e.g. a text layer's style.textAlign or style.backgroundColor), and the font families the renderer embeds ("fonts").

tools.name: get_template_design
tools.description: Return a template's layout as an editable design document (artboard + layers). Costs no quota. Edit it and pass it to create_card as design.

subject.description: username or owner/repo the card is for; decides profile vs repo layouts

palette.description: palette id to apply; replaces the template's background in the returned design

tools.name: get_card_design
tools.description: Return the design document of one of the account's cards, to edit and re-submit through create_card as design (which creates a new card; the original is unchanged).

id.description: card id from create_card or list_cards

tools.name: list_cards
tools.description: List cards this account created through the API, most recently requested first. Paginated with nextCursor.

tools.name: delete_card
tools.description: Permanently delete one of the account's cards. Its links stop working everywhere they are embedded. Confirm with the user first.

id.description: card id from create_card or list_cards

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Show the account's plan (free/pro) and how many cards it can still create today (cards.remaining, resets 00:00 UTC). The ai quota is reserved for future AI tools.
